rule: D45 rule 2: per template under "coded only" through each flipped translator, pooled over the declared seeds: at least 30 patients with a store candidate and an index window, and at most 30% of the distinct child types (PLAN keys; C001 is reference) with a candidate unresolved (a type is unresolved when any of its candidates is). Coded translator: sequence, event frequency and blank, the whole tree and graph refused for their gene step only; joint translator: tree and graph. All candidates and the count without C001, D39's two shapes without the gene step and the templates under stated findings reported

setting.window: from the second seizure, 24 months (the page's own)
setting.free_text: off (coded records only); reported beside it: present (stated findings, the page's default)
setting.translator: trajectory/store_request.js with STORE_CODED_ONLY (coded) or both it and STORE_GENE_CODED_ONLY (joint) on, no options
setting.store: store_parity.py build (the converter emitting series, through the gene wrapper) and match (store_conditions.match, the count post-pass on)

independence: not independent children (D36 review, M1): C001 is the scripted reference child in every seed, and every other child takes archetype, sex, birth year and overrides from the generator's fixed PLAN; only the draws vary with the seed
